array.string: import json,os,sys from pathlib import Path path=Path('/astrid/versions/v1/service-env.json') settings=json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) if path.exists() else {} if (not isinstance(settings,dict) or set(settings)-set(['ASTRID_ALLOW_UNQUALIFIED_GPU', 'ASTRID_WARM_IDLE_SECONDS']) or any(not isinstance(value,str) for value in settings.values())): raise ValueError('Invalid Astrid service-env.json; use the documented string settings.') os.environ.update(settings) from astrid_runtime.cli import main sys.exit(main(['run', '--profile', 'astrid', '--data-root', '/astrid data', '--source-manifest', '/astrid/versions/v1/profile.json']))
